title: Imports and Exports Control Amendment Regulation 1983

sections.shortTitle: Imports and Exports Control Amendment Regulation 1983
sections.description:
REGULATION I OF 1983
IMPORTS AND
EXPORTS (CONTROL) (AMENDMENT) REGULATION, 1983
REGULATION I OF 1983
A Regulation to
amend the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, 1950 in its application to the
Tribal Areas
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 22nd February, 1983]
No. F. 5 (1)-F. III/82.-The
following Regulation made by the President is hereby published for general
information :-
Whereas it is expedient to amend
the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, 1950 (XXXIX of 1950), in its application
to the Tribal Areas ;
Now, therefore, in pursuance of
the Proclamation of the fifty day of July, 1977, and in exercise of all powers
enabling him in that behalf, the President is pleased to make the following
Regulation :-
1. Short title, extent and
commencement.-(1) This Regulation may be called the Imports and Exports
(Control) (Amendment) Regulation, 1983.
(2) It extends to the whole of
the Tribal Areas.
(3) It shall come into force at
once.
2. Amendment of section 1, Act
XXXIX of 1950.-In the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, 1950 (XXXIX of
1950), in section 1, in subsection (3), the comma and words ", and shall
remain in force for a period of twenty years" shall be omitted and shall
be deemed to have been so omitted on the eighteenth day of April, 1970.
